evals.name: resolve-instances-to-exports
evals.prompt: `notification-settings.json` in the workspace root is the metadata dump of the `Notification settings` frame in our Figma library. Build that screen as a React component at `src/NotificationSettings.tsx`, with the `@pagopa/ui` design system this workspace depends on. The deliverable is the component source only: do not install, build or test anything.
evals.expected_output: `src/NotificationSettings.tsx` renders the four parts of the frame with the `@pagopa/ui` components the Figma map resolves for their component-set ids (Banner, TextField, Separator, Button), imports them from `@pagopa/ui`, and loads the library stylesheet.
expectations: Resolves each part through the `componentId` on its instance (for example instance `4102:91` -> component set `261:6501`), never through the instance's own node id.
Resolves the component-set ids with the Figma map CLI (`pagopa-ui-map resolve <id>`) and takes each part's status and export from that answer.
Renders the `Divider` instance with the `Separator` export the map names for `61:2786`, instead of inventing a `Divider` component.
Imports every rendered part from `@pagopa/ui` and loads `@pagopa/ui/styles.css`; no mapped part is re-implemented by hand.

evals.name: pending-node-guardrail
evals.prompt: `search-results.json` in the workspace root is the metadata dump of the `Search results` frame in our Figma library. Build that screen as a React component at `src/SearchResults.tsx`, with the `@pagopa/ui` design system this workspace depends on. The deliverable is the component source only: do not install, build or test anything.
evals.expected_output: `src/SearchResults.tsx` renders the frame's mapped parts with their `@pagopa/ui` exports, reports the `Pagination` component set (`127:1510`) as pending and asks before building it, and leaves the `Scrollbar` (`610:33637`) out because the map marks it excluded.
expectations: Reports that `127:1510` (Pagination) is pending and asks for a decision, instead of substituting another component or hand-rolling pagination.
Leaves `610:33637` (Scrollbar) out of the screen, because the map marks it excluded as native OS chrome.
Still renders the `Tag` and `Button` parts with the exports the map resolves for `105:2043` and `108:1402`.
